systems.system: Smart Village IT equipment for local entities
systems.country_label: programme Smart Village / Rapid Rural Transformation
systems.platform: Computer equipment; satellite internet with off-grid solar power at the sites
systems.owner: Ministère du Développement numérique, des postes et des télécommunications, with the World Food Programme
systems.tiers: 11 local entities in Androy and Anosy, among them gendarmerie services, districts, hospitals, schools, communes and agricultural services; six sites operational as of 3 February 2026

note: Computers given to gendarmerie services among 11 local entities, to automate some administrative procedures and improve reporting (class enabling); no record system is named and nothing is said on how a brigade records a complaint.
